title: Structure engineering hero
description: A full-bleed, darkened photo slideshow a little taller than the window, with a huge tight neo-grotesk statement in white over its lower half and, along the bottom, a ruled 'browse' label over outlined mono tags beside a ruled 'latest' label over three small white project cards (thumbnail, mono sector, name) that invert to ink on hover. Photos settle from 92% scale and the text rises 80px on load; every few seconds the next photo slides in from the right. On phones the cards become a sideways row with the next one peeking.
notes: the text is light over a dark photo: it assumes dark images (placeholders are the theme's glow with a dark veil)
height follows the window: 100svh + 92px on phones, + 58px at desktop, like the original
the slideshow advances on a timer (React effect); reduced motion keeps the first slide
name: structureengineering-hero
